promptCorrections:
<OOC>
DO NOT advance the story. Your task is to rewrite your LAST message (in msgtorework)  incorporating this specific change: {{input}}.

CRITICAL RULES:

1. You MUST output the ENTIRE rewritten message from start to finish. Do not just output the changed fragments.

2. PRESERVE the original text! Keep the wording, structure, and length of the rest of the message EXACTLY the same.

3. STRICTLY ONLY modify the exact sentences required for the change. You are FORBIDDEN from altering even a single word, punctuation mark, or character in any other part of the text, regardless of perceived improvements.
</OOC>
promptSeparatedThinking:
[Earlier conversation history (oldest first; the top may be truncated by context limits):
[[{{chat}}]]

--- End of history ---

Currently shown message to correct:
[[{{message}}]]

OOC: Answer out of character. Do not continue the RP. You are correcting the currently shown message above using the complete chat for context.

Task:
 1. Identify every logical, situational, continuity, spatial, factual, motivation, character-knowledge, metagaming, and behavioural error, including any repetitions of phrases or scenes, in the currently shown message.
 2. Think about each error separately and decide the best possible fix while considering that you may ONLY change the currently shown message.
 3. Implement all fixes in one revised version of the currently shown message.
 4. Keep the message as close to the original as possible except where a fix is needed, but the rewrite for the fix can be as extensive as needed to implement it flawlessly.
 5. Do not explain the errors. Do not include analysis, bullet points, labels, quotes, or code fences.
 6. Return ONLY the corrected message text.]
